850413.name: IMG1
850413.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human MRPL19 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein L19). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850420.name: THR4
850420.summary: Enables pyridoxal phosphate binding activity and threonine synthase activity. Involved in L-threonine biosynthetic process. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to several human genes including THNSL2 (threonine synthase like 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850423.name: YIH1
850423.summary: Enables actin monomer binding activity; protein kinase inhibitor activity; and ribosome binding activity. Involved in several processes, including GCN2-mediated signaling; cellular response to amino acid starvation; and negative regulation of phosphorylation. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to human IMPACT (impact RWD domain protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850429.name: HCM1
850429.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity and mitochondrial transcription factor activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to oxidative stress; regulation of DNA-templated transcription; and spindle pole body organization. Located in chromatin; cytoplasm; and nucleus. Is active in mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in blepharophimosis, ptosis, and epicanthus inversus syndrome; lung non-small cell carcinoma; primary ciliary dyskinesia 43; primary ovarian insufficiency 3; and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to several human genes including FOXA2 (forkhead box A2); FOXD2 (forkhead box D2); and FOXJ1 (forkhead box J1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850432.name: ATG15
850432.summary: Enables glycerophospholipase activity. Involved in several processes, including macroautophagy; multivesicular body membrane disassembly; and phosphatidylserine catabolic process. Located in membrane and vacuolar lumen. Is active in endoplasmic reticulum and vacuolar membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850434.name: IMG2
850434.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human MRPL49 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein L49). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850437.name: SOL2
850437.summary: Predicted to enable 6-phosphogluconolactonase activity. Involved in tRNA export from nucleus. Located in cytosol. Orthologous to human PGLS (6-phosphogluconolactonase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850450.name: ABP1
850450.summary: Enables actin filament binding activity. Involved in actin cortical patch assembly; protein localization to actin cortical patch; and regulation of actin filament organization. Located in actin cortical patch. Orthologous to human DBNL (drebrin like). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850507.name: RPO41
850507.summary: Enables DNA-directed RNA polymerase activity. Involved in DNA replication, synthesis of primer and mitochondrial transcription. Located in mitochondrial nucleoid. Part of mitochondrial DNA-directed RNA polymerase complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency 55. Orthologous to human POLRMT (RNA polymerase mitochondrial). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850511.name: RIM15
850511.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to heat; cellular response to nitrogen starvation; and positive regulation of cell cycle process. Acts upstream of or within cellular response to hydrogen peroxide. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in thrombocytopenia. Orthologous to human MASTL (microtubule associated serine/threonine kinase like). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850519.name: BST1
850519.summary: Enables phosphatidylinositol deacylase activity. Involved in several processes, including ERAD pathway; GPI anchor metabolic process; and protein retention in ER lumen. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Orthologous to human PGAP1 (post-GPI attachment to proteins inositol deacylase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850527.name: LPD1
850527.summary: Enables dihydrolipoyl dehydrogenase (NADH) activity; glycine dehydrogenase (decarboxylating) activity; and oxoglutarate dehydrogenase (succinyl-transferring) activity. Involved in several processes, including 2-oxoglutarate metabolic process; alpha-amino acid metabolic process; and hydrogen peroxide metabolic process. Located in mitochondrial nucleoid. Part of glycine cleavage complex; oxoglutarate dehydrogenase complex; and pyruvate dehydrogenase complex. Used to study disease of metabolism. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in dihydrolipoamide dehydrogenase deficiency. Orthologous to human DLD (dihydrolipoamide dehydrogenase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850551.name: LOC1
850551.summary: Enables several functions, including RNA binding activity; RNA folding chaperone; and molecular condensate scaffold activity. Involved in intracellular mRNA localization; negative regulation of translation; and ribosome biogenesis. Located in nucleolus. Part of preribosome, large subunit precursor and protein folding chaperone complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850559.name: FAR7
850559.summary: Involved in re-entry into mitotic cell cycle after pheromone arrest. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850562.name: UBP6
850562.summary: Enables cysteine-type deubiquitinase activity. Involved in mitochondria-associated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process; protein deubiquitination; and regulation of proteasomal protein catabolic process. Part of proteasome regulatory particle. Used to study prion disease. Orthologous to human USP14 (ubiquitin specific peptidase 14). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850577.name: ATG18
850577.summary: Enables phosphatidylinositol phosphate binding activity and ubiquitin binding activity. Involved in several processes, including macroautophagy; vacuolar protein processing; and vacuolar transport. Acts upstream of or within autophagosome assembly and protein targeting to vacuole involved in autophagy. Located in several cellular components, including fungal-type vacuole membrane; phagophore; and phagophore assembly site membrane. Part of CROP complex and PAS complex. Orthologous to human WIPI1 (WD repeat domain, phosphoinositide interacting 1) and WIPI2 (WD repeat domain, phosphoinositide interacting 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850580.name: LSB3
850580.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity. Involved in actin cortical patch localization. Located in cellular bud neck and mitochondrion. Orthologous to human SH3YL1 (SH3 and SYLF domain containing 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850592.name: RPL29
850592.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in cytoplasmic translation. Located in cytoplasm. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL29 (ribosomal protein L29). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850597.name: CDC26
850597.summary: Contributes to ubiquitin protein ligase activity. Involved in anaphase-promoting complex-dependent catabolic process; chromatin organization; and protein ubiquitination. Located in cytosol and nucleus. Part of anaphase-promoting complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850605.name: DUG1
850605.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity; metallodipeptidase activity; and omega peptidase activity. Involved in glutathione catabolic process. Located in cytoplasm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in glomerulonephritis. Orthologous to human CNDP1 (carnosine dipeptidase 1) and CNDP2 (carnosine dipeptidase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850608.name: BNA6
850608.summary: Enables nicotinate-nucleotide diphosphorylase (carboxylating) activity. Involved in 'de novo' NAD+ biosynthetic process from L-tryptophan. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to human QPRT (quinolinate phosphoribosyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850609.name: RMD8
850609.summary: Located in endoplasmic reticulum. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850620.name: UBI4
850620.summary: Enables protein tag activity. Involved in protein ubiquitination. Located in peroxisome. Orthologous to human UBC (ubiquitin C). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850631.name: TPO1
850631.summary: Enables spermidine transmembrane transporter activity and spermine transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in cellular response to oxidative stress and polyamine transport. Located in cellular bud membrane and fungal-type vacuole membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850633.name: HSP104
850633.summary: Enables several functions, including ATP hydrolysis activity; adenyl ribonucleotide binding activity; and unfolded protein binding activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular heat acclimation; protein folding in endoplasmic reticulum; and protein unfolding. Located in cytoplasm and nuclear periphery. Part of TRC complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in 3-methylglutaconic aciduria type 7a; 3-methylglutaconic aciduria type 7b; and severe congenital neutropenia. Orthologous to human CLPB (ClpB family mitochondrial disaggregase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850645.name: BPT1
850645.summary: Enables cadmium ion transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in cadmium ion transport and vacuole fusion, non-autophagic. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in arterial calcification of infancy; coronary artery disease; and pseudoxanthoma elasticum. Orthologous to human ABCC6 (ATP binding cassette subfamily C member 6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850675.name: FRE6
850675.summary: Enables ferric-chelate reductase activity. Involved in copper ion import. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850682.name: RPL8B
850682.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Involved in maturation of LSU-rRNA. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL7A (ribosomal protein L7a). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850684.name: ATG10
850684.summary: Enables Atg12 transferase activity. Involved in several processes, including autophagy of mitochondrion; cytoplasm to vacuole targeting by the Cvt pathway; and piecemeal microautophagy of the nucleus. Predicted to be located in phagophore assembly site membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850685.name: SDH2
850685.description: succinate dehydrogenase iron-sulfur protein subunit SDH2
850685.otherdesignations: succinate dehydrogenase iron-sulfur protein subunit SDH2
850685.nomenclaturename: succinate dehydrogenase iron-sulfur protein subunit SDH2
850685.summary: Enables succinate dehydrogenase (quinone) activity. Involved in mitochondrial electron transport, succinate to ubiquinone and tricarboxylic acid cycle. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Part of respiratory chain complex II (succinate dehydrogenase). Used to study mitochondrial encephalomyopathy and paraganglioma. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Carney-Stratakis syndrome; gastrointestinal stromal tumor; mitochondrial complex II deficiency; and pheochromocytoma (multiple). Orthologous to human SDHB (succinate dehydrogenase complex iron sulfur subunit B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850686.name: DNM1
850686.summary: Enables GTPase activity and identical protein binding activity. Involved in several processes, including mitochondrion inheritance; organelle fission; and protein homooligomerization. Acts upstream of or within intracellular distribution of mitochondria; membrane bending; and membrane fission. Located in cytosol; mitochondrial outer membrane; and peroxisome. Is active in mitochondrion. Used to study encephalopathy due to defective mitochondrial and peroxisomal fission 1. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in encephalopathy due to defective mitochondrial and peroxisomal fission 1 and optic atrophy 5. Orthologous to human DNM1L (dynamin 1 like). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850692.name: SSK1
850692.description: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase SSK1
850692.otherdesignations: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase SSK1
850692.nomenclaturename: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase SSK1
850692.summary: Enables mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase binding activity; phosphorelay response regulator activity; and protein kinase activator activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to acidic pH; cellular response to osmotic stress; and regulation of p38MAPK cascade. Is active in cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850710.name: IZH3
850710.summary: Predicted to enable signaling receptor activity. Involved in intracellular zinc ion homeostasis. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in breast cancer; macular degeneration; metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease; prostate adenocarcinoma; and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to human ADIPOR1 (adiponectin receptor 1) and ADIPOR2 (adiponectin receptor 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850711.name: UBR2
850711.summary: Enables ubiquitin-protein transferase activity. Involved in cellular response to unfolded protein; cytoplasm protein quality control by the ubiquitin-proteasome system; and protein polyubiquitination. Located in cytoplasm. Part of MUB1-RAD6-UBR2 ubiquitin ligase complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Johanson-Blizzard syndrome and cardiovascular system disease. Orthologous to human UBR1 (ubiquitin protein ligase E3 component n-recognin 1) and UBR2 (ubiquitin protein ligase E3 component n-recognin 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850714.name: AAT2
850714.summary: Enables L-aspartate:2-oxoglutarate transaminase activity and ribosomal large subunit binding activity. Involved in L-aspartate biosynthetic process. Acts upstream of or within negative regulation of translation in response to oxidative stress. Located in cytosol and peroxisome. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in amyloidosis; amyotrophic lateral sclerosis; developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 82; pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma; and transient cerebral ischemia. Orthologous to several human genes including GOT1 (glutamic-oxaloacetic transaminase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850732.name: TRX1
850732.summary: Enables disulfide oxidoreductase activity. Involved in several processes, including Golgi vesicle transport; cell redox homeostasis; and vacuole organization. Located in cytosol and mitochondrial intermembrane space. Orthologous to human TXN (thioredoxin). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850733.name: PDC1
850733.summary: Enables branched-chain-2-oxoacid decarboxylase activity and pyruvate decarboxylase activity. Involved in aromatic amino acid family catabolic process and pyruvate fermentation to ethanol. Located in cytosol and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850737.name: RPS0B
850737.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in cytoplasmic translation and ribosome biogenesis. Part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to several human genes including RPSA (ribosomal protein SA). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850744.name: SPT8
850744.summary: Enables TBP-class protein binding activity and transcription coregulator activity. Involved in chromatin organization; negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. Part of SAGA complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850747.name: SHM2
850747.summary: Enables glycine hydroxymethyltransferase activity. Involved in one-carbon metabolic process. Located in cytoplasm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in breast cancer and neurodevelopmental disorder with cardiomyopathy, spasticity, and brain abnormalities. Orthologous to several human genes including SHMT1 (serine hydroxymethyltransferase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850750.name: RPL22A
850750.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to several human genes including RPL22L1 (ribosomal protein L22 like 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850756.name: PET309
850756.summary: Enables mRNA binding activity and translation activator activity. Involved in mitochondrial respiratory chain complex IV assembly and positive regulation of mitochondrial translational initiation. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850764.name: RPL10
850764.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in ribosomal large subunit assembly and translational termination. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Used to study T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia; autistic disorder; spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia congenita; and syndromic X-linked intellectual disability Najm type. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autistic disorder; spermatogenic failure 63; and syndromic X-linked mental retardation 35. Orthologous to human RPL10 (ribosomal protein L10) and RPL10L (ribosomal protein L10 like). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850768.name: SIC1
850768.description: cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase inhibiting protein SIC1
850768.otherdesignations: cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase inhibiting protein SIC1
850768.nomenclaturename: cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase inhibiting protein SIC1
850768.summary: Enables SCF ubiquitin ligase complex binding activity and cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase inhibitor activity. Involved in G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle and negative regulation of macroautophagy. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850782.name: NYV1
850782.summary: Enables SNAP receptor activity. Involved in vacuolar calcium ion homeostasis; vacuole fusion, non-autophagic; and vesicle fusion. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane. Part of SNARE complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850786.name: HRT3
850786.description: SCF ubiquitin ligase complex subunit HRT3
850786.otherdesignations: SCF ubiquitin ligase complex subunit HRT3
850786.nomenclaturename: SCF ubiquitin ligase complex subunit HRT3
850786.summary: Predicted to enable ubiquitin-like ligase-substrate adaptor activity. Predicted to contribute to ubiquitin-protein transferase activity. Involved in SCF-dependent proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process and cellular response to methylmercury. Part of SCF ubiquitin ligase complex. Orthologous to human FBXO9 (F-box protein 9). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850792.name: APC9
850792.summary: Contributes to ubiquitin protein ligase activity. Involved in anaphase-promoting complex-dependent catabolic process; chromatin organization; and protein ubiquitination. Part of anaphase-promoting complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850794.name: LCL2
850794.summary: Involved in ERAD pathway. Located in fungal-type vacuole. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850819.name: DCN1
850819.summary: Enables several functions, including cullin family protein binding activity; ubiquitin conjugating enzyme binding activity; and ubiquitin-like protein binding activity. Involved in protein neddylation. Predicted to be part of ubiquitin ligase complex. Orthologous to several human genes including DCUN1D1 (defective in cullin neddylation 1 domain containing 1); DCUN1D2 (defective in cullin neddylation 1 domain containing 2); and DCUN1D3 (defective in cullin neddylation 1 domain containing 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850827.name: TIS11
850827.summary: Enables mRNA binding activity and translation repressor activity. Involved in several processes, including electron transport coupled proton transport; negative regulation of gene expression; and response to iron ion starvation. Located in nucleus. Is active in mitochondrion. Orthologous to several human genes including ZFP36 (ZFP36 zinc finger CCCH-type). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850846.name: ACS2
850846.summary: Enables acetyl-CoA synthetase activity and acid-ammonia (or amide) ligase activity. Involved in acetyl-CoA biosynthetic process. Located in cytosol and nucleolus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in orofacial cleft. Orthologous to several human genes including ACSS1 (acyl-CoA synthetase short chain family member 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850865.name: UPS2
850865.summary: Predicted to enable phosphatidic acid transfer activity. Involved in several processes, including cristae formation; glycerophospholipid metabolic process; and negative regulation of phosphatidylcholine biosynthetic process. Located in mitochondrial intermembrane space. Orthologous to human PRELID3A (PRELI domain containing 3A) and PRELID3B (PRELI domain containing 3B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850871.name: IDP2
850871.summary: Enables isocitrate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity. Involved in isocitrate metabolic process. Located in cytosol. Used to study high grade glioma. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including D-2-hydroxyglutaric aciduria 2; carcinoma (multiple); hematologic cancer (multiple); high grade glioma (multiple); and lung cancer (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including IDH1 (isocitrate dehydrogenase (NADP(+)) 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850873.name: RFX1
850873.summary: Enables RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to several human genes including RFX2 (regulatory factor X2) and RFX4 (regulatory factor X4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850877.name: SAM1
850877.summary: Enables methionine adenosyltransferase activity. Involved in L-methionine metabolic process and S-adenosylmethionine biosynthetic process. Acts upstream of or within negative regulation of stress granule assembly. Located in cytoplasmic stress granule. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hypermethioninemia and lung cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including MAT1A (methionine adenosyltransferase 1A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850878.name: VTA1
850878.summary: Enables ATPase activator activity and protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. Involved in late endosome to vacuole transport via multivesicular body sorting pathway. Located in multivesicular body. Part of ESCRT IV complex. Orthologous to human VTA1 (vesicle trafficking 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850879.name: SWI6
850879.summary: Enables transcription coactivator activity. Involved in several processes, including G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle; cellular response to heat; and positive regulation of reciprocal meiotic recombination. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Part of MBF transcription complex and SBF transcription complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850882.name: RPL37A
850882.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in cleavage in ITS2 between 5.8S rRNA and LSU-rRNA of tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit and preribosome, large subunit precursor. Orthologous to human RPL37 (ribosomal protein L37). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850892.name: NMT1
850892.summary: Enables glycylpeptide N-tetradecanoyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein localization to membrane. Located in cytosol. Orthologous to several human genes including NMT2 (N-myristoyltransferase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850901.name: QRI5
850901.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in mRNA processing; mitochondrial ribosome assembly; and mitochondrial translational initiation. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Part of mitochondrial small ribosomal subunit. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850904.name: HRD3
850904.summary: Contributes to ubiquitin-protein transferase activity. Involved in negative regulation of protein autoubiquitination and retrograde protein transport, ER to cytosol. Located in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Part of Hrd1p ubiquitin ligase ERAD-L complex; Hrd1p ubiquitin ligase ERAD-M complex; and luminal surveillance complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pancreatic cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including SEL1L (SEL1L adaptor subunit of SYVN1 ubiquitin ligase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850939.name: FAR10
850939.summary: Involved in re-entry into mitotic cell cycle after pheromone arrest. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Orthologous to human SLMAP (sarcolemma associated protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850940.name: LIP2
850940.summary: Enables ligase activity. Involved in protein lipoylation. Located in mitochondrion. Used to study dystonia and glycine encephalopathy. Orthologous to human LIPT2 (lipoyl(octanoyl) transferase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850941.name: VPS34
850941.otheraliases: YLR240W, END12, PEP15, STT8, VPL7, VPS7, VPT29
850941.summary: Enables 1-phosphatidylinositol-3-kinase activity and protein kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to potassium ion starvation; pexophagy; and positive regulation of transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II. Located in several cellular components, including fungal-type vacuole membrane; nucleus-vacuole junction; and phagophore assembly site. Part of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase complex, class III, type I and phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase complex, class III, type II. Used to study Parkinson's disease. Orthologous to human PIK3C3 (phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase catalytic subunit type 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850952.name: SSP120
850952.summary: Predicted to enable calcium ion binding activity. Located in fungal-type vacuole. Orthologous to human NUCB1 (nucleobindin 1) and NUCB2 (nucleobindin 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

850953.name: SYM1
850953.summary: Involved in ethanol metabolic process. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Used to study mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 3; mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 6; and mitochondrial metabolism disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2EE and mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 6. Orthologous to several human genes including MPV17 (mitochondrial inner membrane protein MPV17). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850962.name: GSY2
850962.summary: Enables alpha-1,4-glucan glucosyltransferase (UDP-glucose donor) activity; glycogen binding activity; and identical protein binding activity. Involved in glycogen biosynthetic process. Located in glycogen granule. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in cardiovascular system disease and glycogen storage disease. Orthologous to human GYS1 (glycogen synthase 1) and GYS2 (glycogen synthase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

850966.name: YPT6
850966.summary: Enables GTPase activity. Involved in several processes, including Golgi vesicle transport; cytoplasm to vacuole targeting by the Cvt pathway; and protein localization to phagophore assembly site. Located in cis-Golgi network and cytosol. Is active in phagophore assembly site. Orthologous to several human genes including RAB6A (RAB6A, member RAS oncogene family) and RAB6B (RAB6B, member RAS oncogene family). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851010.name: MET17
851010.summary: Enables O-acetylhomoserine sulfhydrylase activity and cysteine synthase activity. Involved in L-homocysteine biosynthetic process; L-methionine metabolic process; and sulfate assimilation. Located in cytoplasm and plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851015.name: UBC12
851015.summary: Enables NEDD8 transferase activity. Involved in protein neddylation. Predicted to be active in cytosol and nucleus. Orthologous to human UBE2M (ubiquitin conjugating enzyme E2 M). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851019.name: CDC25
851019.description: Ras family guanine nucleotide exchange factor CDC25
851019.otherdesignations: Ras family guanine nucleotide exchange factor CDC25
851019.nomenclaturename: Ras family guanine nucleotide exchange factor CDC25
851019.summary: Enables guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. Involved in Ras protein signal transduction and traversing start control point of mitotic cell cycle. Located in several cellular components, including cytosol; endoplasmic reticulum membrane; and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Noonan syndrome (multiple); atrial heart septal defect; gingival fibromatosis; and pulmonary valve stenosis. Orthologous to human SOS1 (SOS Ras/Rac guanine nucleotide exchange factor 1) and SOS2 (SOS Ras/Rho guanine nucleotide exchange factor 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851021.name: ATG39
851021.summary: Enables protein-macromolecule adaptor activity. Involved in cellular response to nitrogen starvation; nucleophagy; and reticulophagy. Located in nuclear outer membrane and perinuclear endoplasmic reticulum. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851029.name: BUD6
851029.summary: Enables actin binding activity; cytoskeletal regulatory protein binding activity; and enzyme activator activity. Involved in several processes, including bipolar cellular bud site selection; cytoskeleton organization; and positive regulation of supramolecular fiber organization. Located in several cellular components, including cellular bud tip; incipient cellular bud site; and mating projection tip. Part of polarisome. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851051.name: VRP1
851051.summary: Enables actin binding activity. Involved in several processes, including actin cortical patch localization; bipolar cellular bud site selection; and positive regulation of Arp2/3 complex-mediated actin nucleation. Located in actin cortical patch; cellular bud neck; and incipient cellular bud site. Orthologous to human WIPF1 (WAS/WASL interacting protein family member 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851058.name: RPL26A
851058.summary: Enables RNA binding activity. A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Diamond-Blackfan anemia 11. Orthologous to human RPL26 (ribosomal protein L26) and RPL26L1 (ribosomal protein L26 like 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851068.name: TAL1
851068.summary: Enables transaldolase activity. Involved in pentose-phosphate shunt. Located in nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in carbohydrate metabolic disorder. Orthologous to human TALDO1 (transaldolase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851074.name: VPS38
851074.summary: Predicted to enable SNARE binding activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to potassium ion starvation; late endosome to vacuole transport; and phosphatidylinositol phosphate biosynthetic process. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane. Part of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase complex, class III, type II. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851076.name: STE11
851076.description: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase STE11
851076.otherdesignations: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase STE11
851076.nomenclaturename: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase STE11
851076.summary: Enables MAP kinase kinase kinase activity; SAM domain binding activity; and identical protein binding activity. Involved in several processes, including intracellular signal transduction; invasive growth in response to glucose limitation; and pseudohyphal growth. Located in cytoplasm. Orthologous to human MAP3K2 (mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 2) and MAP3K3 (mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase kinase 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851077.name: NMD4
851077.summary: Involved in nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, nonsense-mediated decay. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851086.name: ROM2
851086.description: Rho family guanine nucleotide exchange factor ROM2
851086.otherdesignations: Rho family guanine nucleotide exchange factor ROM2
851086.nomenclaturename: Rho family guanine nucleotide exchange factor ROM2
851086.summary: Enables guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity and phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate binding activity. Involved in several processes, including positive regulation of cellular component organization; regulation of fungal-type cell wall organization; and small GTPase-mediated signal transduction. Located in cellular bud tip; incipient cellular bud site; and mating projection tip. Orthologous to human ARHGEF3 (Rho guanine nucleotide exchange factor 3) and NET1 (neuroepithelial cell transforming 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851088.name: VID22
851088.summary: Enables G-quadruplex DNA binding activity. Involved in protein catabolic process in the vacuole. Acts upstream of or within chromatin remodeling. Located in nucleus and plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Apr 2025]

851092.name: FBP1
851092.summary: Enables fructose 1,6-bisphosphate 1-phosphatase activity. Involved in gluconeogenesis and reactive oxygen species metabolic process. Located in cytosol and periplasmic space. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase deficiency. Orthologous to human FBP1 (fructose-bisphosphatase 1) and FBP2 (fructose-bisphosphatase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851098.name: NAM2
851098.summary: Enables leucine-tRNA ligase activity and pre-mRNA intronic binding activity. Involved in gene expression. Located in mitochondrion. Used to study Perrault syndrome and mitochondrial metabolism disease. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Perrault syndrome. Orthologous to human LARS2 (leucyl-tRNA synthetase 2, mitochondrial). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851100.name: IKI3
851100.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity and tRNA binding activity. Involved in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and tRNA wobble uridine modification. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Part of elongator holoenzyme complex. Used to study familial dysautonomia. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in asthma; familial dysautonomia; kyphosis; medulloblastoma; and scoliosis. Orthologous to human ELP1 (elongator acetyltransferase complex subunit 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851120.name: SEI1
851120.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity. Involved in lipid droplet formation; protein localization to lipid droplet; and regulation of lipid biosynthetic process. Acts upstream of or within acylglycerol homeostasis and phospholipid homeostasis. Located in cortical endoplasmic reticulum; endoplasmic reticulum membrane; and lipid droplet. Used to study congenital generalized lipodystrophy and congenital generalized lipodystrophy type 2. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851132.name: PUN1
851132.summary: Involved in fungal-type cell wall organization. Located in plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851141.name: DCK1
851141.summary: Predicted to enable guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity and small GTPase binding activity. Involved in autophagy of mitochondrion and intracellular signal transduction. Located in mitochondrion and plasma membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in attention deficit hyperactivity disorder and immunodeficiency 40. Orthologous to several human genes including DOCK2 (dedicator of cytokinesis 2); DOCK4 (dedicator of cytokinesis 4); and DOCK5 (dedicator of cytokinesis 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851142.name: ATG17
851142.summary: Enables SNARE binding activity; molecular adaptor activity; and protein kinase activator activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to nitrogen starvation; macroautophagy; and positive regulation of autophagosome assembly. Located in phagophore assembly site and vacuole-isolation membrane contact site. Part of Atg1/ULK1 kinase complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851146.name: TDA5
851146.summary: Predicted to enable oxidoreductase activity, acting on the CH-OH group of donors, NAD or NADP as acceptor. Involved in response to xenobiotic stimulus. Located in endoplasmic reticulum and mitochondrion. Orthologous to several human genes including DHRS3 (dehydrogenase/reductase 3); HSD17B11 (hydroxysteroid 17-beta dehydrogenase 11); and HSD17B13 (hydroxysteroid 17-beta dehydrogenase 13). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851157.name: DIF1
851157.summary: Predicted to enable ribonucleoside-diphosphate reductase inhibitor activity. Involved in protein import into nucleus. Is active in cytoplasm. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851160.name: MRPL4
851160.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in mitochondrial translation. Acts upstream of or within mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit assembly. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human MRPL47 (mitochondrial ribosomal protein L47). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851163.name: SIR3
851163.summary: Enables DNA binding activity; identical protein binding activity; and nucleosome binding activity. Involved in several processes, including double-strand break repair via nonhomologous end joining; establishment of protein-containing complex localization to telomere; and negative regulation of gene expression. Located in chromosome, telomeric region; heterochromatin; and nucleolus. Part of chromatin silencing complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Meier-Gorlin syndrome 1. Orthologous to human ORC1 (origin recognition complex subunit 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851166.name: GMC2
851166.summary: Involved in protein sumoylation; reciprocal meiotic recombination; and synaptonemal complex assembly. Located in peroxisome and synaptonemal complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851168.name: VMA6
851168.description: H(+)-transporting V0 sector ATPase subunit d
851168.otherdesignations: H(+)-transporting V0 sector ATPase subunit d
851168.nomenclaturename: H(+)-transporting V0 sector ATPase subunit d
851168.summary: Contributes to proton-transporting ATPase activity, rotational mechanism. Involved in proton transmembrane transport and vacuolar transport. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane. Part of vacuolar proton-transporting V-type ATPase, V0 domain. Orthologous to human ATP6V0D1 (ATPase H+ transporting V0 subunit d1) and ATP6V0D2 (ATPase H+ transporting V0 subunit d2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851169.name: RPL6B
851169.summary: Enables RNA binding activity. A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in cytoplasmic translation and ribosomal large subunit assembly. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL6 (ribosomal protein L6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851172.name: LEU3
851172.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. Involved in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; positive regulation of L-leucine biosynthetic process; and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851182.name: YLR460C
851182.summary: Predicted to enable oxidoreductase activity, acting on NAD(P)H. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851191.name: CLN3
851191.summary: Enables cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase regulator activity. Involved in several processes, including G1/S transition of mitotic cell cycle; traversing start control point of mitotic cell cycle; and vacuole fusion, non-autophagic. Located in nucleus. Used to study amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851192.name: CYC3
851192.summary: Enables holocytochrome-c synthase activity. Involved in cytochrome c-heme linkage. Located in mitochondrial intermembrane space. Used to study microphthalmia. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in linear skin defects with multiple congenital anomalies 1 and microphthalmia. Orthologous to human HCCS (holocytochrome c synthase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]
